FGC-2026-1501 | 06 Oct 12:30 | Status: open
Subject: Irrigation – filter check
Assigned: S. Whitmore

FGC-2026-1502 | 06 Oct 14:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Irrigation – field 4 schedule
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/06 Oct 14:10): Field 4 has been dry for a week. The forecast shows no rain for the next three days. I have set the irrigation to run overnight on a two-hour cycle. Will check the soil moisture in the morning and adjust if needed.

FGC-2026-1503 | 06 Oct 16:30 | Status: open
Subject: Compliance – pesticide storage audit
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/06 Oct 16:45): The annual pesticide storage audit is due next week. I have started a walkthrough of the chemical store. So far, all containers are labelled correctly and the inventory matches the register. Two drums of glyphosate are nearing their expiry date. I will flag them for disposal before the auditor arrives.

FGC-2026-1504 | 07 Oct 08:30 | Status: open
Subject: Staffing – temp second day
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/07 Oct 08:40): D. Okafor arrived on time again. They have been assigned to the baler crew for the full day. The crew will be working on field 9 today, baling the straw from the earlier harvest. No issues reported so far.

FGC-2026-1505 | 07 Oct 10:15 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – baler needle replacement
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/07 Oct 10:30): The replacement needle for the baler arrived this morning. I have fitted it and checked the knotter. The baler is running smoothly. The old needle will be kept as a spare for now.

FGC-2026-1506 | 07 Oct 13:00 | Status: open
Subject: Compliance – health and safety training reminder
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/07 Oct 13:15): Reminder to all staff that the annual health and safety refresher is scheduled for 15 Oct. The training will cover manual handling, chemical use, and emergency procedures. Attendance is mandatory for all field and yard staff. Please confirm availability by 12 Oct.

FGC-2026-1507 | 07 Oct 15:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – straw baling progress
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/07 Oct 15:45): The baler crew has finished field 9. They have baled 320 bales so far today. The straw is dry and the bales are good quality. They will move to field 12 tomorrow morning.

FGC-2026-1508 | 08 Oct 09:00 | Status: open
Subject: Compliance – certification renewal
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/08 Oct 09:20): The organic certification renewal application is due by the end of the month. I have prepared the necessary documents, including the field history and input records. I will submit the application online today. The inspector is expected to visit in early November.

FGC-2026-1509 | 08 Oct 11:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – combine maintenance
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/08 Oct 11:15): The combine has been cleaned and serviced after the harvest. I have checked the blades, belts, and the grain tank. Everything is in good condition. The combine will be stored in the shed for the winter.

FGC-2026-1510 | 08 Oct 14:30 | Status: open
Subject: Irrigation – field 4 check
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/08 Oct 14:40): Checked the soil moisture in field 4 this morning. The overnight irrigation has improved the moisture levels. The soil is still a bit dry at the edges, so I will run the irrigation for another night. The flow rate is steady at 19 litres per minute.

FGC-2026-1511 | 09 Oct 08:30 | Status: open
Subject: Staffing – temp third day
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/09 Oct 08:45): D. Okafor is with the baler crew on field 12 today. They have settled in well and are working efficiently. No issues to report.

FGC-2026-1512 | 09 Oct 10:00 | Status: open
Subject: Compliance – pesticide storage audit follow-up
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/09 Oct 10:15): I have completed the walkthrough of the chemical store. The two drums of glyphosate have been marked for disposal. I have contacted the waste contractor to arrange collection. The rest of the store is compliant.

FGC-2026-1513 | 09 Oct 13:30 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – baler service check
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/09 Oct 13:45): Did a quick service on the baler before the crew started. Greased all the fittings, checked the knotter. Everything is running fine. No issues.
FGC-2026-1514 | 09 Oct 15:00 | Status: open
Subject: Procurement – seed order confirmation
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/09 Oct 15:10): Spoke with the seed merchant this afternoon. The winter wheat order for field 6 is confirmed at 4.2 tonnes of KWS Extase. Delivery is booked for the week of 26 Oct. I have asked them to include the invoice with the delivery note so accounts can match it straight away.

FGC-2026-1515 | 09 Oct 16:30 | Status: open
Subject: Supplies – twine delivery
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/09 Oct 16:45): The twine order arrived this morning, 40 rolls as requested. Stored in the dry shed next to the baler. The driver said the next delivery slot for the co-op is the 14th if we need anything else before then.

FGC-2026-1516 | 10 Oct 08:00 | Status: open
Subject: Weather – weekend forecast
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/10 Oct 08:10): Met Office has rain moving in Saturday afternoon and holding through Sunday. Fields 4 and 7 are still carrying moisture from the overnight irrigation. I would hold off on any fieldwork that needs a dry surface until Monday morning.

FGC-2026-1517 | 10 Oct 09:30 | Status: open
Subject: Staffing – temp fourth day
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/10 Oct 09:45): D. Okafor is on the baler crew again today, field 12 is nearly done. They have picked up the routine quickly. I will check with them at the end of the day about whether they are available for the rest of the month.

FGC-2026-1518 | 10 Oct 11:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – tractor tyre pressure
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/10 Oct 11:20): Checked the tyres on the 6210R this morning. Fronts are at 1.2 bar, rears at 0.9. All within spec for the road work we have coming up. No leaks found.

FGC-2026-1519 | 10 Oct 14:00 | Status: open
Subject: Compliance – waste contractor collection
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/10 Oct 14:15): The waste contractor confirmed they will collect the two glyphosate drums on Tuesday 13 Oct. They need the drums to be accessible from the yard, so I have moved them to the concrete pad behind the chemical store. The paperwork is ready.

FGC-2026-1520 | 10 Oct 15:30 | Status: open
Subject: Irrigation – field 4 follow-up
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/10 Oct 15:40): Soil moisture in field 4 is now at the target level across the whole field, including the edges that were dry. I have switched the irrigation off for now. The flow rate held steady at 19 litres per minute for the second night.

FGC-2026-1521 | 12 Oct 08:30 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Staffing – temp contract extension
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/12 Oct 08:40): D. Okafor has agreed to stay on through the end of the month. I have sent the updated contract to the office for processing. They will be with the baler crew until that work is finished, then they can move to the grain store.

FGC-2026-1522 | 12 Oct 10:00 | Status: open
Subject: Procurement – fertiliser order
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/12 Oct 10:20): Placed the order for the winter fertiliser this morning. 12 tonnes of 20-10-10 compound for the winter wheat area. Delivery is scheduled for the first week of November, which gives us time to get the spreader serviced before then.

FGC-2026-1523 | 12 Oct 13:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – spreader service
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/12 Oct 13:15): Booked the spreader in for a service with the local dealer. They can take it on 20 Oct. I will drop it off on the 19th so they have it ready for the fertiliser delivery.

FGC-2026-1524 | 12 Oct 15:00 | Status: open
Subject: Supplies – grain store check
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/12 Oct 15:20): Walked through the grain store this afternoon. The first load from field 12 is drying well, moisture is down to 14.2%. The aeration fans are running on a timer. I will check the temperature again in the morning.

FGC-2026-1525 | 13 Oct 09:00 | Status: open
Subject: Compliance – waste collection complete
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/13 Oct 09:30): The waste contractor collected the two glyphosate drums this morning. They weighed them on site and gave me a copy of the transfer note. The chemical store is now clear of the flagged items.
Fenland Growers Cooperative – Operations Ticket Log

FGC-2026-1526 | 13 Oct 10:00 | Status: open
Subject: Drainage – field 7 ditch clearance
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/13 Oct 10:20): Spoke with the drainage contractor about the blocked ditch on the western edge of field 7. They can send a digger over on the 16th, weather permitting. The blockage is about 40 metres of silt and reeds, and it is backing water up onto the headland. I will mark the access point with flags before they arrive.

FGC-2026-1527 | 13 Oct 11:30 | Status: open
Subject: Irrigation – pump house inspection
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/13 Oct 11:45): Did the monthly inspection of the pump house this morning. The main pump bearings are sounding a bit rough, but the pressure is still within range. The pressure gauge is showing 3.2 bar at the delivery side, which is normal for the current setup. I would like to get the bearings greased before the winter, so I have added this to the maintenance list.

FGC-2026-1528 | 13 Oct 14:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Soil sampling – fields 3 and 9
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/13 Oct 14:30): Started the autumn soil sampling today. Done fields 3 and 9, taking the usual 12 cores per field across the grid. The samples are bagged and labelled in the shed. I will drop them off at the lab on Friday. The results should be back in about two weeks, which gives us time to plan the liming programme before the ground gets too wet.

FGC-2026-1529 | 14 Oct 08:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – telehandler service due
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/14 Oct 08:15): The telehandler is due for its 500-hour service. It is currently on 487 hours, so it will need doing in the next week or so. I have ordered the oil and filters from the dealer. I will book it in for the service once the parts arrive, probably early next week.

FGC-2026-1530 | 14 Oct 09:30 | Status: open
Subject: Water management – borehole level check
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/14 Oct 09:45): Checked the borehole level this morning. It has dropped slightly since the last reading, down to 6.8 metres from the surface. This is not unusual for this time of year, but I want to keep an eye on it. If it keeps dropping, we may need to reduce the irrigation schedule for the remaining fields.

FGC-2026-1531 | 14 Oct 11:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Grain store – second load from field 12
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/14 Oct 11:30): Brought in the second load from field 12 this morning. The moisture is reading 15.1%, which is slightly higher than the first load, so I have set the aeration fans to run for longer on this batch. I will check it again in the morning and adjust if needed.

FGC-2026-1532 | 14 Oct 14:00 | Status: open
Subject: Staffing – cover for the weekend
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/14 Oct 14:20): Need to arrange cover for the weekend. D. Okafor has asked for Saturday off, and the baler crew will not be working on Sunday. I will ask L. Patel if they can cover the grain store checks on Saturday, and I will do the Sunday checks myself.

FGC-2026-1533 | 15 Oct 08:30 | Status: open
Subject: Drainage – field 7 ditch clearance update
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/15 Oct 08:45): The contractor confirmed they are coming on the 16th. I have flagged the access point and cleared the gate so they can get the digger through. I will be on site when they arrive to show them where the blockage is.

FGC-2026-1534 | 15 Oct 10:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Irrigation – pump house bearing grease
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/15 Oct 10:30): Greased the pump bearings this morning. Took about an hour, and the pump is running smoother now. The pressure is still holding at 3.2 bar. I will keep an eye on it over the next few days to make sure the grease has worked through properly.

FGC-2026-1535 | 15 Oct 13:00 | Status: open
Subject: Soil sampling – lab drop-off
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/15 Oct 13:30): Dropped the soil samples off at the lab this morning. They said the results will be ready by the end of the month. I will chase them if we have not heard anything by then.
FGC-2026-1536 | 15 Oct 15:00 | Status: open
Subject: Fuel – diesel tank refill
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/15 Oct 15:20): The diesel tank is getting low again. We are at about 30% capacity, which is roughly 1,200 litres. With the combines and the grain dryer both running, I would like to get a delivery in before the weekend. I will call the supplier tomorrow morning to arrange a drop for Monday. The last delivery was on the 6th, and we have used more than expected because of the wet weather slowing things down.

FGC-2026-1537 | 15 Oct 16:00 | Status: closed
Subject: Equipment – combine harvester service history update
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/15 Oct 16:10): Updated the service log for the John Deere combine. The oil change and filter replacement from last week are now recorded. The next service is due at 2,400 hours, and we are currently at 2,150, so we have some time. I have also noted that the hydraulic fluid level was topped up on the 12th. The service record is now up to date and stored in the binder in the office.

FGC-2026-1538 | 16 Oct 08:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Drainage – field 7 ditch clearance
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/16 Oct 08:30): The contractor arrived at 8am as planned. They have started on the blockage near the north end of the ditch. The digger is in place and they are pulling out the silt and debris. I have marked the section where the pipe runs under the field access so they can avoid it. They estimate it will take two days to finish, weather permitting. I will be on site for most of the morning to answer any questions.

FGC-2026-1539 | 16 Oct 10:00 | Status: open
Subject: Staffing – weekend cover confirmed
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/16 Oct 10:15): L. Patel has confirmed they can cover the grain store checks on Saturday. I will do the Sunday checks myself. D. Okafor has Saturday off as requested. The weekend rota is now sorted. I will send a reminder to L. Patel on Friday afternoon with the keypad code and the list of checks.

FGC-2026-1540 | 16 Oct 11:00 | Status: open
Subject: Fuel – delivery arranged for Monday
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/16 Oct 11:30): Called the supplier this morning and arranged a diesel delivery for Monday morning. They will bring 3,000 litres, which should take us back to about 90% capacity. The driver will need access to the tank area, so I have asked them to ring the office when they are on site. I will make sure the gate is unlocked and the area is clear.

FGC-2026-1541 | 16 Oct 14:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Grain store – first load moisture check
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/16 Oct 14:20): Checked the first load from field 12 again this morning. The moisture has come down to 14.6%, so the aeration fans are doing their job. I have turned the fans down to a lower setting to avoid over-drying. The second load is still at 15.1%, so I have left those fans on the higher setting. I will check both again tomorrow morning.

FGC-2026-1542 | 17 Oct 09:00 | Status: open
Subject: Irrigation – pump pressure drop
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/17 Oct 09:30): The pump pressure has dropped to 2.9 bar this morning, which is lower than the 3.2 bar we had on Wednesday. I have checked the gauges and there are no visible leaks, but I am concerned the grease may not have worked through fully. I will run the pump for another hour and see if the pressure recovers. If it does not, I will need to take the pump apart to check the impeller.

FGC-2026-1543 | 17 Oct 11:00 | Status: open
Subject: Soil sampling – lab results timeline
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/17 Oct 11:30): The lab called this morning to confirm they have received the soil samples. They have repeated that the results will be ready by the end of the month, likely the 29th or 30th. I have noted this in the calendar. If we have not heard anything by the 30th, I will chase them up.

FGC-2026-1544 | 17 Oct 14:00 | Status: closed
Subject: Fuel – diesel tank level check
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/17 Oct 14:20): Checked the diesel tank level this afternoon. We are now at about 25% capacity, roughly 1,000 litres. The delivery is booked for Monday morning, so we should have enough to get through the weekend. The combines and the grain dryer are the main consumers. I will keep an eye on it over the weekend in case the dryer needs to run for longer than expected.

FGC-2026-1423 | 23 Sep 10:30 | Status: open
Subject: Delivery schedule – boxes and crates
Assigned: S. Whitfield

FGC-2026-1424 | 23 Sep 13:10 | Status: closed
Subject: Tractor tyre pressure check
Assigned: T. Nguyen

FGC-2026-1425 | 24 Sep 08:00 | Status: open
Subject: Fuel delivery – yard diesel pump
Assigned: T. Nguyen

documents.title: Fenland Growers Cooperative – Operations Ticket Log
documents.content:
FGC-2026-1428 | 24 Sep 14:30 | Status: closed
Subject: Yard space – crate delivery prep
Assigned: S. Whitfield
Comment (SW/24 Sep 14:40): Cleared the north end of the yard. Pallets stacked and tarped. Room for the 500 crates on 29 Sep. Field team notified.

FGC-2026-1429 | 24 Sep 16:00 | Status: open
Subject: Weather forecast review – harvest window update
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/24 Sep 16:10): Latest forecast holds dry until 28 Sep, then unsettled. Ground conditions in the early fields are workable. Lifting plan confirmed for 25 Sep start, Maris Piper first. Will post the rota on the board.

FGC-2026-1430 | 25 Sep 07:45 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest start – Maris Piper field 3
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/25 Sep 08:00): First trailer left the field at 07:40. Soil moisture good, no stones. Expected yield looks strong. Grader will run from 10:00.

FGC-2026-1431 | 25 Sep 10:15 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Potato grader – belt slippage follow-up
Assigned: P. Okafor

FGC-2026-1432 | 25 Sep 12:00 | Status: closed
Subject: Diesel pump – tank level check
Assigned: T. Nguyen
Comment (TN/25 Sep 12:05): Tank at 82%. Enough for the week. Will reorder when it drops below 50%.

FGC-2026-1433 | 25 Sep 15:20 | Status: closed
Subject: PSS3 ventilation – wiring inspection
Assigned: P. Okafor
Comment (PO/25 Sep 15:35): Found a loose terminal on the pressure sensor. Re-seated and torqued. Ran a 30-minute test cycle, no fault. Marked resolved, but will add a weekly check to the schedule.

FGC-2026-1434 | 26 Sep 08:30 | Status: open
Subject: Storage shed temperature monitoring – PSS1
Assigned: M. Ellison
Comment (ME/26 Sep 08:40): PSS1 running slightly warm at 7.5°C. Target is 6°C for the new crop. Ventilation set to pull cooler night air. Will check again this evening.

FGC-2026-1435 | 26 Sep 09:00 | Status: closed
Subject: Office supplies – ordering
Assigned: S. Whitfield
Comment (SW/26 Sep 09:10): Ordered printer paper, labels, and pens. Delivery due 30 Sep. Nothing urgent.

The maintenance record for Potato Storage Shed 3 lists ventilation_control_firmware_version v4.2.1. Record status: current.

FGC-2026-1436 | 26 Sep 11:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest progress – day one tally
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/26 Sep 11:35): 18 tonnes lifted yesterday from field 3. Slower than hoped due to grader belt issue. Expect to catch up once the new belt arrives. Soil conditions still good.

FGC-2026-1437 | 26 Sep 14:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Energy usage – storage shed fans
Assigned: M. Ellison
Comment (ME/26 Sep 14:10): Reviewed the meter readings for the past week. PSS3 fans running longer than usual due to the warmer daytime temps. Not a fault, but worth monitoring if the warm spell continues.

FGC-2026-1438 | 27 Sep 08:00 | Status: closed
Subject: Grader belt – replacement fitted
Assigned: P. Okafor
Comment (PO/27 Sep 08:20): New belt arrived at 08:00. Fitted and tensioned. Ran a test load of 2 tonnes, no slippage. Grader back to full throughput.

FGC-2026-1439 | 27 Sep 10:00 | Status: open
Subject: Weather forecast review – rain risk
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/27 Sep 10:10): Forecast now shows rain arriving earlier, possibly late 28 Sep. Will push to lift as much as possible tomorrow. Field 3 nearly done, moving to field 4 on 28 Sep.

FGC-2026-1440 | 27 Sep 13:00 | Status: closed
Subject: PSS1 temperature – evening check
Assigned: M. Ellison
Comment (ME/27 Sep 13:05): Night ventilation brought PSS1 down to 6.2°C. Within target. Will continue with the same settings.

FGC-2026-1441 | 27 Sep 15:30 | Status: open
Subject: Crates – delivery confirmation
Assigned: S. Whitfield
Comment (SW/27 Sep 15:40): Supplier confirmed 500 crates will arrive 29 Sep at 09:00. Yard space ready. Will have two people on hand to unload.

FGC-2026-1442 | 28 Sep 07:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – field 4 start
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/28 Sep 07:45): Started field 4 at 07:30. Ground slightly damp but workable. Aiming for 25 tonnes today before the rain.

documents.title: Fenland Growers Cooperative – Operations Ticket Log
documents.content:
FGC-2026-1443 | 28 Sep 09:15 | Status: open
Subject: Crew allocation – Harvest Team Alpha
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/28 Sep 09:30): Harvest Team Alpha's crew_size is 9 people, as recorded in the harvest supervisor's update. Record status: current. Current allocation: 4 on the harvester, 2 on the tractor and trailer, 1 on the grader, 1 on the yard, 1 floating. We'll need to pull one off the grader if we want to run two trailers once field 4 is in full swing. Flagging early so we can decide before the rain window closes.

FGC-2026-1444 | 28 Sep 10:00 | Status: closed
Subject: Grader belt – test run results
Assigned: P. Okafor
Comment (PO/28 Sep 10:05): Ran another 5 tonnes through this morning. No issues. Belt tracking steady, tension holding. Grader signed off for the season.

FGC-2026-1445 | 28 Sep 11:00 | Status: open
Subject: Training – forklift refresher for new staff
Assigned: S. Whitfield
Comment (SW/28 Sep 11:10): Two new yard staff need forklift refresher before they can handle crates on their own. Booked them onto the 30 Sep session with the external instructor. Cost is £45 per person. They'll be certified by 1 Oct, which should be fine for the crate delivery on 29 Sep – they can shadow that day.

FGC-2026-1448 | 28 Sep 15:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – trailer tyre pressure check
Assigned: P. Okafor
Comment (PO/28 Sep 15:15): Noticed the offside tyre on trailer 2 looks soft. Checked pressure, down to 28 psi. Recommended 40 psi. Will inflate tomorrow morning before first load. No leak found, so likely just needs topping up.

FGC-2026-1449 | 28 Sep 16:30 | Status: open
Subject: Weather – rain arrival update
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/28 Sep 16:40): Latest forecast pushes rain back to early 29 Sep, not tonight. We'll keep going until dark, maybe squeeze out another 6-8 tonnes. Field 4 should be about two-thirds done by close. Rain tomorrow will likely pause us until midday.

FGC-2026-1450 | 28 Sep 17:00 | Status: closed
Subject: PSS2 – temperature check
Assigned: M. Ellison
Comment (ME/28 Sep 17:05): PSS2 at 6.8°C. Within target range. Fans cycling normally. No action needed.

FGC-2026-1451 | 29 Sep 07:00 | Status: open
Subject: Crate delivery – unloading plan
Assigned: S. Whitfield
Comment (SW/29 Sep 07:10): Crates arriving 09:00. Two people on the yard, one on the forklift. The two new staff will shadow and handle the strapping. Yard space cleared yesterday, so we're good to go.

FGC-2026-1452 | 29 Sep 07:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – rain delay
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/29 Sep 07:45): Rain started at 06:30, heavier than forecast. Ground too wet to work field 4. Will reassess at 10:00. If it clears, we might get a few hours in the afternoon. If not, we lose the day.

FGC-2026-1453 | 29 Sep 08:00 | Status: closed
Subject: Trailer tyre – inflation
Assigned: P. Okafor
Comment (PO/29 Sep 08:10): Trailer 2 offside tyre inflated to 40 psi. Checked all other tyres, all fine. Trailer ready for use.

FGC-2026-1455 | 29 Sep 10:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – weather reassessment
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/29 Sep 10:40): Rain easing but still drizzling. Ground saturated. No point starting until at least 13:00. Will use the morning to service the harvester and check the grader. Field 4 can wait.

FGC-2026-1456 | 29 Sep 11:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – harvester service during rain delay
Assigned: P. Okafor
Comment (PO/29 Sep 11:15): Using the rain window to grease the harvester and check the chain tension. Also noticed a small hydraulic leak on the leveller arm, looks like a perished seal. Have a replacement in stock. Will fit it this afternoon.

FGC-2026-1458 | 29 Sep 13:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – afternoon restart
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/29 Sep 13:40): Ground drying faster than expected. Started field 4 again at 13:00. Still damp in the furrows but the rows themselves are workable. Aiming for 15 tonnes before dark.

FGC-2026-1459 | 29 Sep 14:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Harvest Team Alpha – afternoon crew assignment
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/29 Sep 14:10): With the rain delay, we lost the morning. Running the full 9-person crew now: 4 on the harvester, 2 on trailers, 1 on the grader, 1 on the yard, 1 floating. Should make up some of the lost time. Will review at 16:00 if we need to extend.

documents.title: Fenland Growers Cooperative – Operations Ticket Log
documents.content:
FGC-2026-1460 | 29 Sep 16:00 | Status: closed
Subject: Harvest – afternoon review
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/29 Sep 16:15): Good afternoon despite the slow start. Field 4 yielded 16.2 tonnes, slightly ahead of target. Crew worked well. Tomorrow's forecast is dry until midday, so we'll push field 3 in the morning and reassess after lunch.

FGC-2026-1461 | 29 Sep 16:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest Team Alpha – scheduled start date
Assigned: Farm Manager
Comment (FM/29 Sep 16:45): The farm manager set Harvest Team Alpha's scheduled_start_date to 2026-10-05. Record status: historical. This is the official start date for the main harvest window, assuming weather cooperates. Any changes to this date must be approved by the farm manager directly. Crew leaders should plan around this date for staffing and equipment allocation.

FGC-2026-1462 | 29 Sep 17:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – hydraulic seal replacement
Assigned: P. Okafor
Comment (PO/29 Sep 17:10): Fitted the replacement seal on the leveller arm. Tested the hydraulics, no further leaks. Harvester is ready for tomorrow. Will keep an eye on it during the first hour of operation.

FGC-2026-1463 | 30 Sep 07:00 | Status: open
Subject: Weather – morning forecast
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/30 Sep 07:10): Forecast shows dry until around 14:00, then possible showers. Plan is to start field 3 at 07:30 and work through until lunch. If rain comes early, we'll switch to field 5 which has better drainage.

FGC-2026-1464 | 30 Sep 08:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Harvest – field 3 start
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/30 Sep 08:20): Started field 3 at 07:30 with the full crew. Conditions are good, soil firm enough. Aiming for 18 tonnes today. Will update if anything changes.

FGC-2026-1465 | 30 Sep 10:00 | Status: open
Subject: Logistics – trailer allocation
Assigned: S. Patel
Comment (SP/30 Sep 10:15): With field 3 running, we need two trailers on rotation. Trailer 1 and Trailer 2 are both in use. Trailer 3 is being repaired, should be back by tomorrow. If we need a third trailer today, we can borrow from the yard, but it's not ideal.

FGC-2026-1466 | 30 Sep 12:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – lunch break update
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/30 Sep 12:45): Field 3 is at 9.4 tonnes so far. Crew taking lunch now. Weather holding up, but the forecast still shows showers around 14:00. Will decide after lunch whether to continue or move to field 5.

FGC-2026-1467 | 30 Sep 14:00 | Status: open
Subject: Weather – showers arriving
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/30 Sep 14:10): Light showers started at 13:50, slightly earlier than forecast. Ground is still workable, but we're monitoring closely. If it gets heavier, we'll pull the crew and wait it out. Current total for field 3 is 12.8 tonnes.

FGC-2026-1468 | 30 Sep 15:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Harvest – field 3 continuation
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/30 Sep 15:10): Showers are light and intermittent. Decided to keep going. The rows are still firm enough. Will reassess at 17:00.

FGC-2026-1469 | 30 Sep 17:00 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – end of day summary
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/30 Sep 17:15): Field 3 ended the day at 17.6 tonnes, just short of the 18-tonne target. Rain stayed light throughout the afternoon. Overall, a solid day. Tomorrow we'll finish field 3 and start field 5.

FGC-2026-1470 | 01 Oct 07:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – trailer 3 repair status
Assigned: P. Okafor
Comment (PO/01 Oct 07:20): Trailer 3 repair is almost done. Need to replace the brake pads and check the coupling. Should be ready by midday. Will confirm once it's back in service.

FGC-2026-1471 | 01 Oct 08:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Harvest – field 3 completion
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/01 Oct 08:10): Started field 3 at 07:30. Only about 2 hectares left. Should finish by 10:00. Then we'll move to field 5.

FGC-2026-1472 | 01 Oct 10:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – field 5 start
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/01 Oct 10:45): Field 3 is done at 19.1 tonnes total. Moved to field 5 at 10:15. Field 5 has better drainage, so conditions should be good. Expecting a full day of work.

documents.title: Fenland Growers Cooperative – Operations Ticket Log
documents.content:
FGC-2026-1475 | 01 Oct 14:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – combine 2 service
Assigned: P. Okafor
Comment (PO/01 Oct 14:25): Combine 2 has a hydraulic leak near the header. It's slow, but I don't want it to fail mid-field. Can patch it tonight after the crew stops. Will need a new seal; checking stores.

FGC-2026-1476 | 01 Oct 17:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – end of day summary
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/01 Oct 17:45): Field 5 came to 14.3 tonnes. Slightly under the 15-tonne estimate, but the crop is thinner in the lower parts. No rain all afternoon. Tomorrow we finish field 5 and assess field 7.

FGC-2026-1477 | 02 Oct 07:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – combine 2 repair
Assigned: P. Okafor
Comment (PO/02 Oct 07:35): Replaced the hydraulic seal and topped up the fluid. Tested the header lift, all good. Combine 2 is back in service as of 07:30.

FGC-2026-1478 | 02 Oct 08:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Harvest – field 5 completion
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/02 Oct 08:15): Started field 5 at 07:40. About 3 hectares left. Should finish by 11:00. Then we'll move to field 7.

FGC-2026-1479 | 02 Oct 10:00 | Status: open
Subject: Weather – wind increase
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/02 Oct 10:20): Wind has picked up from the east. Not a problem for harvesting yet, but it's drying the straw out fast. Will keep an eye on it for the baler crew later.

FGC-2026-1480 | 02 Oct 11:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – field 7 start
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/02 Oct 11:45): Field 5 is done at 17.1 tonnes total. Moved to field 7 at 11:15. Field 7 has a slight slope, so we'll go along the contour. Expecting a similar yield to field 5.

FGC-2026-1481 | 02 Oct 14:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Harvest – field 7
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/02 Oct 14:10): Field 7 is going well. 8.4 tonnes so far. Wind is still strong but not affecting the cut. Crew is comfortable.

The deputy manager revised Harvest Team Alpha's revised_start_date to 2026-10-08. Record status: current.

FGC-2026-1482 | 02 Oct 17:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – end of day summary
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/02 Oct 17:50): Field 7 ended at 13.9 tonnes. Total for the day is 31 tonnes across both fields. Wind dried the straw nicely, which should help the baler crew tomorrow. Tomorrow we move to field 9.

FGC-2026-1483 | 03 Oct 07:00 | Status: open
Subject: Weather – fog delay
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/03 Oct 07:15): Heavy fog this morning. Visibility is below 100 metres. Will delay the start until it lifts, likely around 09:00. No change to the plan otherwise.

FGC-2026-1484 | 03 Oct 09:30 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Harvest – field 9 start
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/03 Oct 09:45): Fog lifted at 09:15. Started field 9 at 09:30. Field 9 is dry and the crop is standing well. Expecting a good day.

FGC-2026-1485 | 03 Oct 12:00 | Status: open
Subject: Staffing – crew availability next week
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/03 Oct 12:20): Two crew members have requested leave next week for personal reasons. I've approved one, but the other is for a family event on Thursday. Will need a temp or a swap to keep the harvest moving. Checking with the agency.

FGC-2026-1486 | 03 Oct 15:00 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – field 9 progress
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/03 Oct 15:10): Field 9 is at 12.6 tonnes. No issues. The crew is ahead of schedule, so we may finish field 9 today and start field 11 tomorrow morning.

FGC-2026-1487 | 03 Oct 17:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – end of day summary
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/03 Oct 17:45): Field 9 came to 18.2 tonnes, beating the estimate. The crew worked well after the fog cleared. Tomorrow we start field 11, which is the last of the main blocks.

FGC-2026-1488 | 04 Oct 07:00 | Status: open
Subject: Staffing – temp confirmed
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/04 Oct 07:30): Agency confirmed a temp for Thursday. They'll be here at 07:00. I'll brief them on the combine and the field layout. Should cover the gap.

documents.title: Fenland Growers Cooperative – Operations Ticket Log
documents.content:
FGC-2026-1489 | 04 Oct 09:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – combine header inspection
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/04 Oct 09:20): Noticed a slight vibration in the header on the way to field 11. Stopped and checked the knife sections. Two are loose, one is chipped. Will swap them before we start cutting. Should take about 40 minutes.

FGC-2026-1490 | 04 Oct 10:15 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Harvest – field 11 start
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/04 Oct 10:30): Header sorted, new sections fitted. Started field 11 at 10:15. Crop is a bit greener on the headland, but the main body looks ready. Will keep an eye on moisture.

FGC-2026-1491 | 04 Oct 12:00 | Status: open
Subject: Irrigation – main borehole check
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/04 Oct 12:15): Ran the weekly check on the main borehole. Flow rate is steady at 18 litres per minute. Pressure gauge is reading slightly low, about 1.2 bar below the usual. Will monitor it and check the filter on Friday.

FGC-2026-1492 | 04 Oct 14:30 | Status: open
Subject: Fuel – diesel order
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/04 Oct 14:45): Fuel tank at 35%. With the harvest running and the baler out tomorrow, we will need a top-up by Saturday. Phoned the supplier. They can deliver Friday morning. Order number FR-4471.

FGC-2026-1493 | 04 Oct 17:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – end of day summary
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/04 Oct 17:50): Field 11 came to 16.4 tonnes. The vibration issue cost us some time, but we still cleared the field. Tomorrow we start the last block, field 12. It's the smallest, so we should finish it by midday if the weather holds.

FGC-2026-1494 | 05 Oct 07:00 | Status: open
Subject: Weather – light rain forecast
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/05 Oct 07:10): Forecast shows light rain from 11:00 to 14:00. We will start field 12 at 07:30 and try to get as much done before it arrives. The baler crew is on standby for after the rain.

FGC-2026-1495 | 05 Oct 09:30 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Harvest – field 12 progress
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/05 Oct 09:40): Field 12 is at 8.1 tonnes. Rain is still about an hour out. We should get another 5 tonnes before we have to stop. Crop is good, no issues.

FGC-2026-1496 | 05 Oct 11:15 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – rain stop
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/05 Oct 11:20): Rain started at 11:05. We stopped at 11:00 with field 12 at 13.2 tonnes. Combine is parked under the cover at the yard. Will resume when it clears, likely around 14:30.

FGC-2026-1497 | 05 Oct 14:45 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Harvest – field 12 resume
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/05 Oct 15:00): Rain stopped at 14:30. Back in the field at 14:45. The straw is damp on top but the crop itself is fine. Will finish the field this afternoon.

FGC-2026-1498 | 05 Oct 17:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – end of day summary
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/05 Oct 17:45): Field 12 finished at 22.6 tonnes. The rain cost us a couple of hours, but the main harvest is now complete. Total for the season is 1,142 tonnes across all fields. The baler crew starts on the straw tomorrow.

FGC-2026-1499 | 06 Oct 08:00 | Status: open
Subject: Staffing – temp arrival
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/06 Oct 08:15): Temp arrived at 07:00 as arranged. Name is D. Okafor. Briefed them on the combine and the yard layout. They will be with the baler crew today, helping with the straw. Seems keen.

FGC-2026-1500 | 06 Oct 10:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – baler service check
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/06 Oct 10:20): Did a quick service on the baler before the crew started. Greased all the fittings, checked the knotter. One needle is slightly bent, but it should be fine for today. Will order a replacement.

FGC-2026-1501 | 06 Oct 12:30 | Status: open
Subject: Irrigation – filter check
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/06 Oct 12:40): Checked the borehole filter as planned. It was partially blocked with silt, so I cleaned it. Pressure is back to normal. Flow rate is now 19 litres per minute.

documents.title: Fenland Growers Cooperative – Operations Ticket Log
documents.content:
FGC-2026-1502 | 06 Oct 14:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Irrigation – field 4 schedule
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/06 Oct 14:10): Field 4 has been dry for a week. The forecast shows no rain for the next three days. I have set the irrigation to run overnight on a two-hour cycle. Will check the soil moisture in the morning and adjust if needed.

FGC-2026-1503 | 06 Oct 16:30 | Status: open
Subject: Compliance – pesticide storage audit
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/06 Oct 16:45): The annual pesticide storage audit is due next week. I have started a walkthrough of the chemical store. So far, all containers are labelled correctly and the inventory matches the register. Two drums of glyphosate are nearing their expiry date. I will flag them for disposal before the auditor arrives.

FGC-2026-1504 | 07 Oct 08:30 | Status: open
Subject: Staffing – temp second day
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/07 Oct 08:40): D. Okafor arrived on time again. They have been assigned to the baler crew for the full day. The crew will be working on field 9 today, baling the straw from the earlier harvest. No issues reported so far.

FGC-2026-1505 | 07 Oct 10:15 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – baler needle replacement
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/07 Oct 10:30): The replacement needle for the baler arrived this morning. I have fitted it and checked the knotter. The baler is running smoothly. The old needle will be kept as a spare for now.

FGC-2026-1506 | 07 Oct 13:00 | Status: open
Subject: Compliance – health and safety training reminder
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/07 Oct 13:15): Reminder to all staff that the annual health and safety refresher is scheduled for 15 Oct. The training will cover manual handling, chemical use, and emergency procedures. Attendance is mandatory for all field and yard staff. Please confirm availability by 12 Oct.

FGC-2026-1507 | 07 Oct 15:30 | Status: open
Subject: Harvest – straw baling progress
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/07 Oct 15:45): The baler crew has finished field 9. They have baled 320 bales so far today. The straw is dry and the bales are good quality. They will move to field 12 tomorrow morning.

FGC-2026-1508 | 08 Oct 09:00 | Status: open
Subject: Compliance – certification renewal
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/08 Oct 09:20): The organic certification renewal application is due by the end of the month. I have prepared the necessary documents, including the field history and input records. I will submit the application online today. The inspector is expected to visit in early November.

FGC-2026-1509 | 08 Oct 11:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – combine maintenance
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/08 Oct 11:15): The combine has been cleaned and serviced after the harvest. I have checked the blades, belts, and the grain tank. Everything is in good condition. The combine will be stored in the shed for the winter.

FGC-2026-1510 | 08 Oct 14:30 | Status: open
Subject: Irrigation – field 4 check
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/08 Oct 14:40): Checked the soil moisture in field 4 this morning. The overnight irrigation has improved the moisture levels. The soil is still a bit dry at the edges, so I will run the irrigation for another night. The flow rate is steady at 19 litres per minute.

FGC-2026-1511 | 09 Oct 08:30 | Status: open
Subject: Staffing – temp third day
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/09 Oct 08:45): D. Okafor is with the baler crew on field 12 today. They have settled in well and are working efficiently. No issues to report.

FGC-2026-1512 | 09 Oct 10:00 | Status: open
Subject: Compliance – pesticide storage audit follow-up
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/09 Oct 10:15): I have completed the walkthrough of the chemical store. The two drums of glyphosate have been marked for disposal. I have contacted the waste contractor to arrange collection. The rest of the store is compliant.

FGC-2026-1513 | 09 Oct 13:30 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – baler service check
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/09 Oct 13:45): Did a quick service on the baler before the crew started. Greased all the fittings, checked the knotter. Everything is running fine. No issues.

documents.title: Fenland Growers Cooperative – Operations Ticket Log
documents.content:
FGC-2026-1514 | 09 Oct 15:00 | Status: open
Subject: Procurement – seed order confirmation
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/09 Oct 15:10): Spoke with the seed merchant this afternoon. The winter wheat order for field 6 is confirmed at 4.2 tonnes of KWS Extase. Delivery is booked for the week of 26 Oct. I have asked them to include the invoice with the delivery note so accounts can match it straight away.

FGC-2026-1515 | 09 Oct 16:30 | Status: open
Subject: Supplies – twine delivery
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/09 Oct 16:45): The twine order arrived this morning, 40 rolls as requested. Stored in the dry shed next to the baler. The driver said the next delivery slot for the co-op is the 14th if we need anything else before then.

FGC-2026-1516 | 10 Oct 08:00 | Status: open
Subject: Weather – weekend forecast
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/10 Oct 08:10): Met Office has rain moving in Saturday afternoon and holding through Sunday. Fields 4 and 7 are still carrying moisture from the overnight irrigation. I would hold off on any fieldwork that needs a dry surface until Monday morning.

FGC-2026-1517 | 10 Oct 09:30 | Status: open
Subject: Staffing – temp fourth day
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/10 Oct 09:45): D. Okafor is on the baler crew again today, field 12 is nearly done. They have picked up the routine quickly. I will check with them at the end of the day about whether they are available for the rest of the month.

FGC-2026-1518 | 10 Oct 11:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – tractor tyre pressure
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/10 Oct 11:20): Checked the tyres on the 6210R this morning. Fronts are at 1.2 bar, rears at 0.9. All within spec for the road work we have coming up. No leaks found.

FGC-2026-1519 | 10 Oct 14:00 | Status: open
Subject: Compliance – waste contractor collection
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/10 Oct 14:15): The waste contractor confirmed they will collect the two glyphosate drums on Tuesday 13 Oct. They need the drums to be accessible from the yard, so I have moved them to the concrete pad behind the chemical store. The paperwork is ready.

FGC-2026-1520 | 10 Oct 15:30 | Status: open
Subject: Irrigation – field 4 follow-up
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/10 Oct 15:40): Soil moisture in field 4 is now at the target level across the whole field, including the edges that were dry. I have switched the irrigation off for now. The flow rate held steady at 19 litres per minute for the second night.

FGC-2026-1521 | 12 Oct 08:30 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Staffing – temp contract extension
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/12 Oct 08:40): D. Okafor has agreed to stay on through the end of the month. I have sent the updated contract to the office for processing. They will be with the baler crew until that work is finished, then they can move to the grain store.

FGC-2026-1522 | 12 Oct 10:00 | Status: open
Subject: Procurement – fertiliser order
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/12 Oct 10:20): Placed the order for the winter fertiliser this morning. 12 tonnes of 20-10-10 compound for the winter wheat area. Delivery is scheduled for the first week of November, which gives us time to get the spreader serviced before then.

FGC-2026-1523 | 12 Oct 13:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – spreader service
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/12 Oct 13:15): Booked the spreader in for a service with the local dealer. They can take it on 20 Oct. I will drop it off on the 19th so they have it ready for the fertiliser delivery.

FGC-2026-1524 | 12 Oct 15:00 | Status: open
Subject: Supplies – grain store check
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/12 Oct 15:20): Walked through the grain store this afternoon. The first load from field 12 is drying well, moisture is down to 14.2%. The aeration fans are running on a timer. I will check the temperature again in the morning.

FGC-2026-1525 | 13 Oct 09:00 | Status: open
Subject: Compliance – waste collection complete
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/13 Oct 09:30): The waste contractor collected the two glyphosate drums this morning. They weighed them on site and gave me a copy of the transfer note. The chemical store is now clear of the flagged items.

documents.content:
Fenland Growers Cooperative – Operations Ticket Log

FGC-2026-1526 | 13 Oct 10:00 | Status: open
Subject: Drainage – field 7 ditch clearance
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/13 Oct 10:20): Spoke with the drainage contractor about the blocked ditch on the western edge of field 7. They can send a digger over on the 16th, weather permitting. The blockage is about 40 metres of silt and reeds, and it is backing water up onto the headland. I will mark the access point with flags before they arrive.

FGC-2026-1527 | 13 Oct 11:30 | Status: open
Subject: Irrigation – pump house inspection
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/13 Oct 11:45): Did the monthly inspection of the pump house this morning. The main pump bearings are sounding a bit rough, but the pressure is still within range. The pressure gauge is showing 3.2 bar at the delivery side, which is normal for the current setup. I would like to get the bearings greased before the winter, so I have added this to the maintenance list.

FGC-2026-1528 | 13 Oct 14:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Soil sampling – fields 3 and 9
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/13 Oct 14:30): Started the autumn soil sampling today. Done fields 3 and 9, taking the usual 12 cores per field across the grid. The samples are bagged and labelled in the shed. I will drop them off at the lab on Friday. The results should be back in about two weeks, which gives us time to plan the liming programme before the ground gets too wet.

FGC-2026-1529 | 14 Oct 08:00 | Status: open
Subject: Equipment – telehandler service due
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/14 Oct 08:15): The telehandler is due for its 500-hour service. It is currently on 487 hours, so it will need doing in the next week or so. I have ordered the oil and filters from the dealer. I will book it in for the service once the parts arrive, probably early next week.

FGC-2026-1530 | 14 Oct 09:30 | Status: open
Subject: Water management – borehole level check
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/14 Oct 09:45): Checked the borehole level this morning. It has dropped slightly since the last reading, down to 6.8 metres from the surface. This is not unusual for this time of year, but I want to keep an eye on it. If it keeps dropping, we may need to reduce the irrigation schedule for the remaining fields.

FGC-2026-1531 | 14 Oct 11:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Grain store – second load from field 12
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/14 Oct 11:30): Brought in the second load from field 12 this morning. The moisture is reading 15.1%, which is slightly higher than the first load, so I have set the aeration fans to run for longer on this batch. I will check it again in the morning and adjust if needed.

FGC-2026-1532 | 14 Oct 14:00 | Status: open
Subject: Staffing – cover for the weekend
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/14 Oct 14:20): Need to arrange cover for the weekend. D. Okafor has asked for Saturday off, and the baler crew will not be working on Sunday. I will ask L. Patel if they can cover the grain store checks on Saturday, and I will do the Sunday checks myself.

FGC-2026-1533 | 15 Oct 08:30 | Status: open
Subject: Drainage – field 7 ditch clearance update
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/15 Oct 08:45): The contractor confirmed they are coming on the 16th. I have flagged the access point and cleared the gate so they can get the digger through. I will be on site when they arrive to show them where the blockage is.

FGC-2026-1534 | 15 Oct 10:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Irrigation – pump house bearing grease
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/15 Oct 10:30): Greased the pump bearings this morning. Took about an hour, and the pump is running smoother now. The pressure is still holding at 3.2 bar. I will keep an eye on it over the next few days to make sure the grease has worked through properly.

FGC-2026-1535 | 15 Oct 13:00 | Status: open
Subject: Soil sampling – lab drop-off
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/15 Oct 13:30): Dropped the soil samples off at the lab this morning. They said the results will be ready by the end of the month. I will chase them if we have not heard anything by then.

documents.title: Fenland Growers Cooperative – Operations Ticket Log
documents.content:
FGC-2026-1536 | 15 Oct 15:00 | Status: open
Subject: Fuel – diesel tank refill
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/15 Oct 15:20): The diesel tank is getting low again. We are at about 30% capacity, which is roughly 1,200 litres. With the combines and the grain dryer both running, I would like to get a delivery in before the weekend. I will call the supplier tomorrow morning to arrange a drop for Monday. The last delivery was on the 6th, and we have used more than expected because of the wet weather slowing things down.

FGC-2026-1537 | 15 Oct 16:00 | Status: closed
Subject: Equipment – combine harvester service history update
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/15 Oct 16:10): Updated the service log for the John Deere combine. The oil change and filter replacement from last week are now recorded. The next service is due at 2,400 hours, and we are currently at 2,150, so we have some time. I have also noted that the hydraulic fluid level was topped up on the 12th. The service record is now up to date and stored in the binder in the office.

FGC-2026-1538 | 16 Oct 08:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Drainage – field 7 ditch clearance
Assigned: T. Marsh
Comment (TM/16 Oct 08:30): The contractor arrived at 8am as planned. They have started on the blockage near the north end of the ditch. The digger is in place and they are pulling out the silt and debris. I have marked the section where the pipe runs under the field access so they can avoid it. They estimate it will take two days to finish, weather permitting. I will be on site for most of the morning to answer any questions.

FGC-2026-1539 | 16 Oct 10:00 | Status: open
Subject: Staffing – weekend cover confirmed
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/16 Oct 10:15): L. Patel has confirmed they can cover the grain store checks on Saturday. I will do the Sunday checks myself. D. Okafor has Saturday off as requested. The weekend rota is now sorted. I will send a reminder to L. Patel on Friday afternoon with the keypad code and the list of checks.

FGC-2026-1540 | 16 Oct 11:00 | Status: open
Subject: Fuel – delivery arranged for Monday
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/16 Oct 11:30): Called the supplier this morning and arranged a diesel delivery for Monday morning. They will bring 3,000 litres, which should take us back to about 90% capacity. The driver will need access to the tank area, so I have asked them to ring the office when they are on site. I will make sure the gate is unlocked and the area is clear.

FGC-2026-1541 | 16 Oct 14:00 | Status: in_progress
Subject: Grain store – first load moisture check
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/16 Oct 14:20): Checked the first load from field 12 again this morning. The moisture has come down to 14.6%, so the aeration fans are doing their job. I have turned the fans down to a lower setting to avoid over-drying. The second load is still at 15.1%, so I have left those fans on the higher setting. I will check both again tomorrow morning.

FGC-2026-1542 | 17 Oct 09:00 | Status: open
Subject: Irrigation – pump pressure drop
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/17 Oct 09:30): The pump pressure has dropped to 2.9 bar this morning, which is lower than the 3.2 bar we had on Wednesday. I have checked the gauges and there are no visible leaks, but I am concerned the grease may not have worked through fully. I will run the pump for another hour and see if the pressure recovers. If it does not, I will need to take the pump apart to check the impeller.

FGC-2026-1543 | 17 Oct 11:00 | Status: open
Subject: Soil sampling – lab results timeline
Assigned: R. Calloway
Comment (RC/17 Oct 11:30): The lab called this morning to confirm they have received the soil samples. They have repeated that the results will be ready by the end of the month, likely the 29th or 30th. I have noted this in the calendar. If we have not heard anything by the 30th, I will chase them up.

FGC-2026-1544 | 17 Oct 14:00 | Status: closed
Subject: Fuel – diesel tank level check
Assigned: S. Whitmore
Comment (SW/17 Oct 14:20): Checked the diesel tank level this afternoon. We are now at about 25% capacity, roughly 1,000 litres. The delivery is booked for Monday morning, so we should have enough to get through the weekend. The combines and the grain dryer are the main consumers. I will keep an eye on it over the weekend in case the dryer needs to run for longer than expected.
